background.rule: median of the last points of the curve, as the fit report takes it

counting.why: the detector saw at most 6.108E006 counts/s; no detector_max_cps given to judge it against

plateau_vs_first_order.why: measured ratio 0.250 exceeds the 0.212 the design can give: the plateau is depressed or the two features are against the same ceiling
plateau_vs_first_order.first_order_found_by: largest point in the design's order-1 window 0.8229 to 0.9809 deg theta

total_reflection.why: the scan starts at 0.0477 deg theta, below the design's critical angle 0.2617 deg, and rises to its maximum at 0.2007 deg

orders_visible.why: 4 of the 7 orders in the range are visible; the design scaled to the measured plateau puts 4 above the background. The background is the floor the 2085 zero counts were raised to (1 counts), not a measured noise level, so an order is visible from more than 3 counts

range_below_background.why: 2818 of 4635 points (60.8 %) sit at or below the background; no threshold says how much of a scan may be spent there

sampling.why: 29.43 points per Kiessig fringe (fringe 0.04414 deg, step 0.00150 deg)

footprint.why: sample_length_mm and beam_width_mm are both needed for the footprint knee

zeros.why: 2085 of 4635 points (45.0 %) have a non-positive count, the first at 2.0322 deg theta (4.0645 deg 2theta); they were replaced by the smallest positive count before them and any background taken there is a floor, not a measurement
